text: The README built a written version of the project. An interview needs a spoken version, because the interviewer is listening, not reading — they can't scroll back up.

Situation: the constraint that mattered most. Design: the shape you chose, and why. Trade-off: what you gave up. Retrospect: what you'd do differently now — mapping directly onto the retrospective questions already written down.

"I used Eventstreams and KQL" is the what — nearly interchangeable with any other candidate's answer. "I chose a sliding window because a tumbling one would undercount a burst" is the why — only the person who decided it can say that convincingly.
Practiced out loud, not just understood in your head — that gap only closes with rehearsal. Next up: the finale, closing out this course and the entire track.
